text.description_html:
Sargent 1431, Thru-Bolt Parallel Mounted Door Closer

The Sargent 1431 Powerglide Door Closer is a tri packed to mount on push or pull side of door, and is designed for institutional and other high traffic applications. Includes thru-bolts for secure mounting.

Specifications and Features for the Sargent 1431 Series Commercial Door Closer:

  • Aluminum Powder Coated.
  • Through Bolted
  • 1-1/2" diameter piston
  • Tri-Packed with Universal Standard Arm
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable Back Check
  • Closer Body Length: 12"
  • Exceeds 15 Million cycles
  • Non-Handed
  • All weather fluid.
  • Certified ANSI/BHMA A156.4 Grade 1
  • Spring Size: 1-6
  • UL 10C listed for positive pressure fire test.
  • UL / cUL listed for use on fire rated doors.
  • 25 year limited warranty.
  • High impact non-corrosive plastic covers with two machine screws .

Sold Individually
